hints.title: Smallest Unassigned Card
hints.text: Sort the unique card values and greedily satisfy consecutive group runs starting from the smallest available number.

hints.title: Frequency Consumption Window
hints.text: Maintain frequencies for all values. For each non-zero count at value v, all numbers from v to v + groupSize - 1 must have at least that count.

hints.title: Early Exhaustion Check
hints.text: Subtract the required count from each value in the consecutive window. If any required card has insufficient occurrences, return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of cards in hand
complexity.notes: Sorting distinct card keys and verifying group size runs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching for arbitrary groupings without greedy ordering results in factorial combinatorial branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table for frequencies requires O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedy grouping anchored at the minimum unassigned card.
